thread:
sasha: quick follow-up to the shaper RFC  we prototyped per-model adaptive burst shaping and found a gap: who reconciles token accounting when runtime aborts mid-response?

infra-bot: deploy note: shaper-v1 canary -> staging at 2026-03-15T18:02Z.

matt: summary: admission debits tokens on accept; runtime may abort (OOM/preempt) after some tokens emitted. options: runtime reports final produced_tokens to admission (A), or admission charges optimistic upper bound and runtime issues refunds (B).

aisha: A means admission stays authoritative but needs to wait for finalization; B is simpler but opens refund abuse. metrics also get messy with refunds.

sasha: hybrid idea: admission marks requests provisional when optimistic-charge used. runtime emits terminal event with produced_tokens and abort flag. admission reconciles provisional->committed. provisional has lower weight in fairness windows until committed.

ryan: implementation notes: provisional TTL configurable (suggest 30s). keep a small ephemeral index keyed by request_id per model_variant+tenant. reconcile on final event, expire after TTL. shard by model_variant to avoid hotspots. use async reconciliation to avoid blocking hot paths.

matt: provisional_weight default 0.3. headroom check: block new requests if provisional_weight*provisional + committed >= capacity_threshold. ephemeral provisional entries should influence cache headroom so KV-eviction can free space proactively.

aisha: add fraud detection: if provisional->committed ratio > 0.5 over window, throttle tenant and raise an alert. tests: spike+abort attack, normal burst, mixed tenants, metrics stability.

sasha: telemetry contract: runtime terminal event must include request_id, produced_tokens, aborted (bool), abort_reason?, model_variant, terminal_ts. admission emits windowed sums with provisional_tokens and provisional_weight.

sasha: rollout: feature-flag per-tenant, non-critical models first, 2-week observation, compare fairness variance.

matt: i'll own admission impl + test harness.

ryan: i'll own ephemeral store + perf tests.

aisha: evals and fraud-detector tuning.

infra-bot: reminder: add feature-flag in config service before canary.

sasha: i'll draft RFC follow-up and API contract and link it here. reconvene in 48h. :rocket:
